# Filmmakers System design system

> Bootstrap 6 with the Filmmakers layer. Prototypes MUST load the real CSS and use only Bootstrap 6 markup from the component list. No other UI kit, no custom colours.

## Start here
- [Prototype brief](PROTOTYPE.md): setup, rules, and what not to do
- [Starter page](starter.html): header, subheader band and an empty page, with the CSS loaded

## Design system
- [Component markup](../data/components.json): every component, its classes, rules and example HTML
- [Design tokens](../data/tokens.json)
- [Filmmakers CSS layer](../assets/filmmakers.css)

## Rules
- [Patterns overview](../../patterns/Patterns%20overview): one-line answers
- [Agent instructions](../../AGENTS.md): source order and the ASK rule
- [Product guidelines](../../products/filmmakers-system/README.md)
